name: William Twining
original_name: ウイリアム・トワイニング
source:
Highly intelligent, William has been the top of his class three years running at Stradford School and is also a fifth-year prefect. Despite his family bankruptcy, he maintains lofty dreams of high class society for his future, though he constantly worries about how to pay for his school fees with his considerable financial situation.

William considers himself a realist and doesn't believe in demons or angels, but he starts getting more and more involved with the supernatural, though he strongly wishes to stay out of it. As Solomon's reincarnation, he retains an ability to negate the demonic powers of the 72 pillars demons. As the closest descendant of Solomon, he's also the one who holds Solomon's soul and is the "Elector", the human with the ability to choose the next temporary emperor of Hell while Lucifer rests.
translation:
威廉极其聪明，连续三年在斯特拉福德学校名列全班第一，也是五年级级长。尽管家族破产，他仍怀抱跻身上流社会的远大梦想，却一直为如何支付高昂学费而烦恼。

威廉自认是现实主义者，不相信恶魔或天使，却逐渐被卷入超自然事件，尽管他强烈希望置身事外。作为所罗门的转世，他保留了抵消七十二柱魔神力量的能力。作为所罗门最近的后裔，他也是持有所罗门灵魂的人，是“选帝者”——路西法休息期间，能够选择下一任地狱临时皇帝的人类。
